payload.blocks: Nothing; disk and worktree-list hygiene only.
payload.headline: Remove three 1945 worktrees that confined heads cannot remove

parts.cause: The lead's and the supervisor's confinement refuse fgos worktree remove (git-floor-probe-failed, read-only file system), and no unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is reachable by message.

options.cost: Two commands and one diff look.
options.does: Owner runs: for s in p02r p02v; do fgos worktree remove /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261124-1945-run-tests-fgos-leak-check-$s --delivered-to main; done; then for p02, after checking git -C /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261124-1945-run-tests-fgos-leak-check-p02 diff matches what landed in 9306c5df7, remove it through the same door (discarding its uncommitted copy).
options.harm: p02 loses its uncommitted copy; the landed commit holds the reviewed version.
options.label: Run the removal yourself

options.does: Owner runs the delivered-to-main removal for p02r and p02v only; p02 stays.
options.harm: p02 stays on disk until someone discards it.
options.label: Remove only p02r and p02v

parts.recommendation: Run the removal yourself; --delivered-to main refuses anything not on main, and p02's change is superseded by the reviewed landed commit.

scope.allows: Removing exactly these three worktrees through the worktree door.
scope.forbids: Any other worktree, branch deletion, or a force removal of anything else.

parts.what: Plan 261124-1945 is done (landed main 9306c5df7). Its worktrees p02r and p02v are clean and merged; p02 holds an uncommitted, superseded copy of the same change.

payload.blocks: Nothing landed waits on it; it only upgrades a weak proof of the new leak check to a full one.
payload.headline: Who runs the owed full-suite witness-vs-walk check of the leak-check plan

parts.cause: run-tests takes ~/.local/state/fgos/locks/full-suite.lock first, which is read-only (EROFS) in unit sandboxes; verification ticket c-2670-1795593697937 ran no test. The supervisor is confined the same way and no unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is reachable by message.

options.does: Owner asks the unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session to run step 7 of plans/261124-1945-run-tests-fgos-leak-check/phase-02-attribute-fgos-writes-to-the-test-run.md on a quiet tree (whole-store walk before and after npm test, compared with the witness result) and append one Progress line to the plan.
options.gain: Full proof that the witness misses no test-made .fgos write.
options.harm: Needs a quiet tree: live heads must not write during the run.
options.label: Hand it to lead:SUPERVISOR

options.does: Supervisor files a backlog row for the owed check; it runs when an unconfined runner exists.
options.harm: A miss of the witness (Rust host or shell writes) may go unseen longer.
options.label: Record it as a backlog row

options.does: Step 7 is closed on the 13:30 subset walk.
options.harm: The known blind spot (non-Node writers) stays unmeasured.
options.label: Accept the subset evidence

parts.recommendation: Hand it to lead:SUPERVISOR; it is the one unconfined session that can take the full-suite lock.

scope.allows: One full npm test run plus a throwaway walk script under .fgos/runtime/tmp/, and one Progress line in that plan.md.
scope.forbids: Code changes; if the walk finds a miss, it is reported as a new backlog item, not fixed in this plan.

parts.what: Plan 261124-1945 landed the new .fgos leak check (main 9306c5df7) with phase 2 step 7 weak: the full npm test run with the write witness was never compared against a whole-store .fgos walk. The only evidence is a subset walk (0 misses).
